panels.title: nyxGPT SRE Home -- single pane of glass

options.content:
This is the single pane of glass for nyxGPT SRE work (#3411) -- there is no separate in-app SRE Overview page anymore.

- **Logs** -- [Logs Drilldown, filtered to this app](/a/grafana-lokiexplore-app/explore/job/nyxgpt/logs?from=now-15m&to=now&var-ds=loki&var-filters=job%7C%3D%7Cnyxgpt&patterns=%5B%5D&var-fields=&var-levels=&var-metadata=&var-patterns=&var-lineFilterV2=&var-lineFilters=&timezone=browser&var-lineFormat=&var-jsonFields=&var-all-fields=&urlColumns=%5B%5D&visualizationType=%22logs%22&displayedFields=%5B%5D&userDisplayedFields=false&sortOrder=%22Ascending%22&wrapLogMessage=false&prettifyLogMessage=false)
- **Traces** -- the panel below, backed by the Jaeger datasource
- **Errors** -- the GlitchTip panels below, backed by the Infinity datasource; click through to the [GlitchTip UI](http://localhost:8080) for detail
- **Dashboards** -- [System Overview](/d/nyxgpt-system-overview), [API Metrics](/d/nyxgpt-api-metrics), [RAG Performance](/d/nyxgpt-rag-performance), [Resource Usage](/d/nyxgpt-resource-usage), [Self-Healing](/d/nyxgpt-self-healing), [Canary Rollout](/d/nyxgpt-canary), [Logs Explorer](/d/nyxgpt-logs-explorer)

Prometheus and Jaeger's own native UIs are debug tools now, not primary navigation -- look here first.
